resources.string: Not sharing. Mobile data on, Wi-Fi on (not connected), then tap Start.
Tap a value to copy it.
Turn Wi-Fi on — it doesn\'t need to connect to a network
HopShare needs the Nearby devices (or Location) permission to create the network

On the other device:
1. Join the network above.
2. Set its proxy to Manual with the host and port shown (or use the auto-config URL).

Only apps that respect the system proxy get internet: browsers, most apps. Games, VPNs and anything UDP-based won't.
